notes.title: Loretta is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello y'all! I have great news! [/h2]
[h3]Loretta is now officially Steam Deck Verified!✅[/h3] Very nice~~~

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263781/f498f221bfdc2938bda9ac810eecb86e07daab81.png[/img]

Now, everyone can fully experience playing the game on Steam Deck. The game had passed all the compatibility checks and guaranteed a pleasant time playing the game on the go.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1592540/Loretta/

If you encounter any bugs while playing using the Steam Deck, please let me know!

And thanks for all your support!^^

Sincerely,

Yakov

notes.title: Version 1.1.8 (s) - Live
notes.content:
[h2]Hi. all!

I have updated the Loretta build to version 1.1.8 (s).[/h2] 

[h3]The following changes have been made:[/h3]

- Increased warning text at the beginning of the game;

- Increased the text of item descriptions for English, Russian and Spanish;
[i](Now the text size for all localizations is the same, which should make it easier to read);[/i]

- Added the ability to save settings changes (for example, sound settings) to the Steam Cloud;

- Fixed typos in all types of localizations:

Please, let me know if you run into difficulty while playing!

And thank you for all your support!

Sincerely,

Yakov

notes.title: Trading Cards & Points Shop Items for Loretta
notes.content:
[h1]Hi, all! I have great news! Wow~~[/h1]


[h2]As you may have noticed, Loretta has added Trading Cards & Points Shop Items! Very nice![/h2]

Unique cards, cool badges and stunning backgrounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263781/c8bc38014cc59e10029c68f17206ffd93985264a.png[/img]

And in the Points Shop there is animated backgrounds and avatars.

Get items faster, you guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40263781/09e98f96c83805da1359ccb70d9320c68719ca5c.png[/img]

[h2]And another [b]super announcement![/b][/h2]

[b]Loretta's Artbook[/b] will be available on Steam soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2346520/Loretta_Digital_ArtBook/

[b]Loretta: Digital ArtBook[/b] is a visual booklet that lifts the veil of secrets behind artwork and sources of inspiration of the psychological thriller, Loretta.

It contains 47 unique pieces of art, backgrounds, sprites and portraits created by the contributors, as well as comments from me^^ in PDF format.

In the meantime, feel free to add to your wishlist!

And thanks for your kind words! :3

Sincerely,

Yakov
